Our systems are operating on 24 x 7 basis Ensures optimal network performance, troubleshoot incidents, resolves technical issues, provides technical support and ensure minimal downtime for business continuity Maintains high levels of network availability, security, and compliance with government IT policies and standards Manage ongoing maintenance, technology refresh, support firmware upgrades and security fixes for network equipment (e.g. firewalls, load balancers, switches, wireless controllers, etc) in on-prem data centres and GCC, and ensuring zero-downtime deployments where possible Support office renovations and relocations, including new office setup with LAN, WAN, wireless Internet broadband, cabling works, etc Coordinate with cross-functional teams, vendors and external service providers to resolve technical issues and meet service level agreements (SLAs) Prepare status and progress reports, and present insights to stakeholders and senior management Identify and implement process automation initiatives to reduce manual effort, minimise human error and improve system reliability Maintain operational documentation and SOPs including deployment procedures, production support runbooks, and incident response protocols Manage and support project budgeting, billing, cost tracking and cost recovery activities Manage and resolve day-to-day IT issues related to network, applications, infrastructure and security, to support smooth daily operations Handle routine and ad-hoc operational administration, including logistics and maintenance coordination Support the rollout of new IT infrastructure components and application deployments, ensuring smooth transition into operations Perform other ad-hoc duties as required to ensure efficient and uninterrupted operations
